items.title: How TUI scales threat modeling for 100+ teams with Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Learn how TUI, the world's leading tourism group, built an AI-powered threat modeling system on Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to scale security assessments across more than 100 product teams, cutting threat modeling time by up to 70% while applying security standards consistently.
items.creator: Vushesh Babu Adhikari
